situation: Going on my honeymoon Oct 10 to Oct 26. I'm a project manager at an architecture firm. My colleague Ruth Alvarez (ruth.alvarez@example.com) agreed to cover my two active projects, Harbor Street and Linden School. Need an auto-reply.
reply: I'm away until Tuesday 27 October and not reading email. For the Harbor Street and Linden School projects, Ruth Alvarez (ruth.alvarez@example.com) is covering. Everything else, I'll reply in the week I'm back.
note: Dates in the sender's terms, one named person for the urgent route, under 60 words. The honeymoon doesn't need a mention.

situation: Je suis Camille, graphiste freelance. Je pars trois semaines du 3 au 24 novembre et personne ne me remplace ; je peux lire mes SMS une fois par semaine au 06 12 34 56 78 si le site d'un client en cours tombe. Je veux un message d'absence qui ne fasse pas fuir les nouveaux clients.
reply: Merci pour votre message. Je suis absente du 3 au 24 novembre et je ne lis pas mes e-mails pendant cette période. Pour un client en cours dont le site ne fonctionne plus, un SMS au 06 12 34 56 78 : je le consulte une fois par semaine. Pour un nouveau projet, répondez avec deux lignes sur votre besoin et je vous propose un créneau à partir du 25 novembre. Camille
note: Seule sans remplaçant : une seule voie d'urgence qu'on consulte vraiment, et le message reste une porte d'entrée commerciale.

situation: 我在淘宝开了个手工皂小店，春节要关店，1月25号到2月5号，1月22号前的订单都已经寄出了。想设置一个自动回复，客人问的话能知道还能不能买。
reply: 亲，小店春节休息，1月25日至2月5日暂停发货，2月6日起恢复。这期间可以正常下单，我们开工后按顺序发出；1月22日前的订单都已经寄出啦。留言我们回来后会一一回复，祝新年快乐！
note: 小店客人最关心的是还能不能买、什么时候发货。日期写清楚，其他不用多说。

situation: My dad passed away and I'm taking bereavement leave from Oct 1, back two weeks later. I'm an HR business partner and my colleague Tanya Brooks (tanya.brooks@example.com) agreed to cover. I don't want any details in the auto-reply.
reply: I'm on leave until Thursday 15 October and not reading email. For anything active, please contact Tanya Brooks (tanya.brooks@example.com). Messages here won't be forwarded, so do resend anything important.
note: For bereavement, less detail, not more. Colleagues who need to know will hear it from your team.

situation: I'm Hana, a freelance copywriter, fully booked until Friday Nov 13 and free from Monday Nov 16. I'm getting lots of new inquiries and want an auto-reply that doesn't lose them.
reply: Thanks for getting in touch. I'm fully booked until Friday 13 November, so I can't start anything new before then. If your timeline allows, reply with two lines about the project and your deadline, and I'll hold you a slot from Monday 16 November. Need someone sooner? Say so and I'll suggest a copywriter I trust. Hana
note: An at-capacity auto-reply is still a sales message: the next free date and one easy way to claim it.

situation: I'm Sofia, a senior accountant at a mid-size firm, on parental leave from Monday Oct 5, back Monday Feb 1, and I won't read email at all. My colleague Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@example.com) covers month-end, and our AP team (ap@example.com) handles invoices.
reply: Hi, I'm on parental leave until Monday 1 February and won't be reading email while I'm away. For month-end close and reporting, please contact Marcus Lee at marcus.lee@example.com. For invoices and supplier payments, email ap@example.com. Thanks, Sofia
note: A long leave needs a plain 'won't be read' and two named routes. No baby details in an auto-reply.

situation: 我开了一间定制西装工作室，中秋休息了5天（9月24日到28日），今天刚回来。客户王先生25号发微信问西装能不能在10月10日他婚礼前改好，昨天又发了一句“都好几天了也没人回”。我看了，袖长和腰身要改，10月6日前能改好。
reply: 王先生您好，让您等了好几天，确实着急，谢谢您耐心等我们回来。今天一到店我就先看了您的西装：袖长和腰身10月6日（周二）前能改好，您7日或8日来试穿，如果还要微调，9日前一定交到您手上，赶得上10日的婚礼。您看哪天过来方便？
note: 对方等急了：先承认等得久，不为放假道歉，也不解释，直接给具体日期和下一步。

situation: Friday Oct 2 is my last day as an account manager at Brightline Media. My work email stays live for 30 days after I leave. Clients should go to Keisha Moore (keisha.moore@example.com); everything else to the general inbox, hello@example.com. Need an auto-reply.
reply: Thanks for your email. As of Friday 2 October I've left Brightline Media, and this inbox is no longer read. For client accounts, please contact Keisha Moore (keisha.moore@example.com). For anything else, hello@example.com will route you. It's been a pleasure working with you.
note: Leaving for good: the date, a plain 'no longer read', and two named routes. No new contact details unless your employer is happy with that.

situation: I'm Sam, a solo physiotherapist with my own small clinic in Bristol. I've come down with flu and need to close Wednesday Sept 30 to Friday Oct 2. Nobody covers for me. I want a WhatsApp away message for patients.
reply: Hi, the clinic is closed from Wednesday 30 September to Friday 2 October, and reopens Monday 5 October. If you're booked on those days, I'll message you by Monday to rebook, so there's nothing you need to do. For new pain or an injury that can't wait, please contact your GP or call NHS 111. Sam
note: Solo and sick: the dates, no symptoms, a real route for urgent cases since nobody covers, and the rebooking work taken off patients.

situation: I've been called for jury duty from Monday Oct 5 to Friday Oct 16. I'm a paralegal at a small firm and I'll be away from my desk during court hours but can check email in the evenings. Kevin Tran (kevin.tran@example.com) is covering deadlines.
reply: I'm on jury duty from Monday 5 October to Friday 16 October and away from my desk during the day. I check email once each evening and will reply to anything that can't wait. For filings or court deadlines, please contact Kevin Tran at kevin.tran@example.com. Back at my desk Monday 19 October.
note: Partial availability stated concretely, once each evening, instead of 'limited access', with deadlines routed to one named person.

situation: I'm based in London and I'll be at a conference in Singapore from Oct 12 to 16, back at my desk Monday Oct 19. I'll check Slack once a day around 10am UK time. My teammate Priya Shah covers incidents. I want a Slack status and a short note in the team channel.
reply: At a conference in Singapore 12 to 16 October, back at my desk Monday 19 October. I check Slack once a day, around 10am UK time, so expect replies then. For incidents or anything that can't wait until that check, go to Priya Shah.
note: Partly available is its own promise: say exactly when you look, in the reader's time zone, and name the cover once.

situation: I'm Lily Chen and I run export sales at a furniture factory in Foshan. We close for National Day from Oct 1 to 8 and I'm back Friday Oct 9. Confirmed orders already have the holiday built into their ship dates, but overseas buyers worry every year. Our freight forwarder, Leo Zhang at Pearl Freight (leo.zhang@example.com), stays open for anything already at the port.
reply: Our factory is closed for China's National Day holiday from 1 to 8 October, and I'm back on Friday 9 October. Confirmed orders ship on the dates in your contract; the holiday is already built in. New quotes will be answered by Tuesday 13 October. For a shipment already at the port, please contact Leo Zhang at Pearl Freight, leo.zhang@example.com. Lily Chen, Export Sales
note: For a public holiday abroad, answer the buyer's real worry (does my shipment move?) before anything else.

situation: 我是大学老师，10月12日到25日带研究生去青海做野外考察，山里基本没信号。课程的事找助教张琳（zhanglin@example.com），课题组实验和经费的事找博士后刘洋（liuyang@example.com）。想设一个邮件自动回复。
reply: 您好，我10月12日至25日在青海野外考察，期间基本没有信号，不看邮件，10月26日（周一）回来后统一回复。课程和作业问题请联系助教张琳（zhanglin@example.com）；课题组实验和经费事务请联系刘洋博士（liuyang@example.com）。谢谢！
note: 没信号就直说不看邮件，回来的日期写上星期几，两类事各给一个具体的人。

situation: Me operan de la rodilla el martes 13 de octubre y estaré de baja entre cuatro y seis semanas, todavía no sé la fecha exacta de vuelta. Trabajo en compras en una empresa de alimentación en Valencia y mi compañero Javier Ruiz (javier.ruiz@example.com) me cubre. Quiero una respuesta automática sin dar detalles.
reply: Estoy de baja desde el 13 de octubre y no leo el correo; calculo volver a mediados de noviembre. Para pedidos, proveedores o cualquier asunto urgente, escribe a Javier Ruiz (javier.ruiz@example.com). Los mensajes que lleguen aquí no se reenvían, así que si es importante, mándaselo a él directamente.
note: Con fecha de vuelta incierta, da una estimación honesta y deja claro que nada se reenvía; sin detalles médicos.

situation: 我在一家会计师事务所做审计，从10月12日起改成每周一到周三上班，周四周五不在，长期如此。同组的吴敏（wumin@example.com）负责周四周五的急事。想设一个每周四周五生效的邮件自动回复。
reply: 您好，我每周一至周三上班，周四和周五不查看邮件。您的邮件我会在下周一处理。如有周四、周五必须处理的急事，请联系吴敏（wumin@example.com）。谢谢！
note: 长期固定的不在岗时间，说清楚哪几天在、哪天会回复、急事找谁，不用解释原因。

situation: I'm going on a 10-day silent retreat from Oct 8 to Oct 18 and my phone will be switched off the whole time. I want an away message for texts from friends and family. My brother Tom has the retreat's landline for real emergencies; his number is 07700 900123.
reply: I'm on a silent retreat from 8 to 18 October with my phone switched off, so I won't see messages until Monday 19 October. If it's a real family emergency, call my brother Tom on 07700 900123 and he can reach me. Everything else can wait, and I'll reply when I'm back.
note: A personal away message follows the same shape: the dates, whether you'll see it, and one emergency route through a person who has agreed to it.

situation: I'm a small landlord with four flats and I'm away hiking from Saturday Oct 10 to Sunday Oct 25 with patchy signal. My handyman Dave Morris (07700 900123) has agreed to handle emergencies like a leak or no heating; everything else can wait. Need an auto-reply for tenant emails.
reply: Hi, I'm away until Sunday 25 October with very little signal, so I'll read your email when I'm back. For an emergency like a leak or no heating, call Dave Morris on 07700 900123, who is covering for me. If you smell gas or there is a fire, call the emergency services first. Everything else gets a reply from me the week I'm back.
note: Tenants need to know what counts as urgent, so give examples next to the one emergency route.

situation: I'm a counsellor in private practice in Leeds, away from Monday Oct 19 to Friday Oct 30 and back Monday Nov 2. My colleague Dr Helen Park (helen.park@example.com) has agreed to see existing clients who need a session while I'm away. Some of my clients can go into crisis, so the auto-reply has to say what to do.
reply: Thank you for your email. I'm away from Monday 19 October and back on Monday 2 November, and I won't be reading messages until then. If you are in crisis or feel you might harm yourself, please call 999 or go to your nearest A&E now. If you're an existing client and would like a session before I'm back, please contact Dr Helen Park at helen.park@example.com. Everything else will get a reply in the week I'm back.
note: When a sender could be at risk, the emergency route comes first and in plain words; the cover person and everything else can follow.

situation: Ich bin Jan Keller, selbstständiger Installateur in Kassel, ohne Angestellte. Vom 12. bis 23. Oktober bin ich im Urlaub und ab Montag, 26. Oktober, wieder da. Mein Kollege Stefan Brandt von einem anderen Betrieb übernimmt Notfälle wie Rohrbruch oder Heizungsausfall unter 030 23125 456, und ich brauche eine Ansage für meine Mailbox.
reply: Guten Tag, hier ist die Mailbox von Installateur Jan Keller. Ich bin vom 12. bis 23. Oktober im Urlaub und ab Montag, 26. Oktober, wieder erreichbar; Nachrichten höre ich erst dann ab. Bei einem Notfall wie Rohrbruch oder Heizungsausfall rufen Sie bitte Stefan Brandt an: 030 23125 456. Ich wiederhole: 030 23125 456. Wenn Sie Gas riechen, verlassen Sie das Haus und rufen Sie den Notruf. Vielen Dank.
note: Eine Mailbox-Ansage hört man nur einmal: Rückkehrdatum, ob abgehört wird, die Notfallnummer zweimal, und bei Gasgeruch zuerst der Notruf.

situation: I'm a support engineer on holiday from Tuesday Oct 6, back Monday Oct 19, and I won't read email. Priya Nair (priya.nair@example.com) is covering customer escalations. Our customers know me well and I'd like one light line of humour that doesn't get in the way.
reply: I'm out until Monday 19 October, practising the rare skill of not checking email. For customer escalations, Priya Nair (priya.nair@example.com) has you covered. Everything else, I'll reply in the week I'm back.
note: Humour works as one self-directed line that doesn't delay the dates or the route; the cover is named once.

situation: 我是小学三年级班主任，10月12日到23日去外地参加培训，10月26日周一回学校。家长平时都在微信上找我。这期间孩子请假和班级的事由副班主任刘老师负责，她的电话在班级群公告里。想设一个微信自动回复。
reply: 家长您好，我10月12日至23日在外地参加培训，10月26日（周一）回校，这期间微信消息不能及时回复。孩子请假和班级事务，请直接联系副班主任刘老师，电话见班级群公告。其他事情我回校后统一回复，谢谢理解！
note: 给家长的自动回复：先说日期，请假找谁写清楚，其他事什么时候回复也说明白。

situation: I bake custom celebration cakes from home and take orders by email. I'm on maternity leave from Thursday Oct 15, not baking again until Monday March 1, and nobody covers for me; I'll start reading email again on Monday Feb 1 and will reply in the order messages arrived. Cakes already booked for before Oct 15 are all going ahead.
reply: Thanks for your message. I'm on maternity leave from Thursday 15 October and not baking until Monday 1 March, so I can't take orders for any date before then. I'll read email again from Monday 1 February and reply in the order messages arrived, so if your date is in March or later, include it here. Cakes already booked for before 15 October are all going ahead as planned.
note: Solo with no cover: say plainly that everything waits, and give the date email is read again, not just the reopening date.

situation: I'm a product lead at a software company, back on Monday 5 October from a three-month sabbatical to about 2,400 unread emails. I'll read everything from the last two weeks but archive anything older unread. My colleague Ines Ortiz (ines.ortiz@example.com) covered my projects and is still the right person for anything urgent this week.
reply: Thanks for your email. I'm back as of Monday 5 October after three months away and working through a large backlog. I'm reading everything from the last two weeks; anything older has been archived unread, so if it still matters, please send it again. For anything urgent this week, Ines Ortiz (ines.ortiz@example.com) is the fastest route.
note: A backlog auto-reply is honest triage: say exactly what you will read and how to get the rest seen.

situation: I'm Ruth, the volunteer coordinator at Hillside Community Food Bank. I'm away from Monday 12 October, back Monday 26 October, and won't read email. Volunteers swapping a shift should email my deputy Sam Okoye (sam.okoye@example.com), and anyone who needs a food parcel urgently can call the food bank on 0113 496 0880, staffed Tuesdays and Fridays 10am to 2pm.
reply: Thanks for your email. I'm away from Monday 12 October until Monday 26 October and not reading email. If you need food urgently, please call the food bank on 0113 496 0880, Tuesdays and Fridays, 10am to 2pm. Volunteers swapping a shift, please email Sam Okoye at sam.okoye@example.com. Everything else, I'll reply when I'm back. Ruth
note: When some senders need help rather than an answer, their route goes first, with the hours it is actually staffed.

situation: I'm Marta, support lead at a 12-person software company. Our whole support team is at an offsite from Wednesday Oct 14 to Friday Oct 16, and we'll start reading the shared support inbox again on Monday Oct 19, oldest messages first. Rui Costa is on call for outages only, on 0161 496 0990, and I need the auto-reply for the shared inbox.
reply: Thanks for your email. Our support team is away from Wednesday 14 October to Friday 16 October, and we'll start reading this inbox again on Monday 19 October, oldest messages first. If the service is down and it's stopping your work, call Rui Costa, who is on call, on 0161 496 0990. Everything else will get a reply from us next week. Marta, Support Lead
note: A team inbox follows the same shape as a personal one: dates, what happens to the message, and one named route for the only thing that can't wait.

situation: 父の介護のため、10月19日（月）から11月13日（金）まで休業し、11月16日（月）に復帰します。部品メーカーの営業で、取引先の対応は同じ課の佐藤美咲さん（misaki.sato@example.com）が引き受けてくれました。休む理由は自動返信に書きたくありません。
reply: お問い合わせありがとうございます。10月19日（月）から11月13日（金）まで休暇をいただいており、この期間はメールを確認しておりません。11月16日（月）より順次ご返信いたします。お取引に関するご用件は、佐藤美咲（misaki.sato@example.com）までご連絡ください。こちらのメールは転送されませんので、お急ぎの場合は上記の宛先へ直接お送りください。
note: 介護などの理由は書かず「休暇」で十分。社外向けなので同僚は敬称なしで、名前は一か所だけ。

situation: My manager Elena Ruiz had emergency surgery yesterday and will be off for at least two weeks, with no firm return date yet. HR asked me to set up her auto-reply because IT gave me access; messages to her inbox won't be forwarded. I'm Omar Haddad (omar.haddad@example.com), I'm covering her team's work, and she wouldn't want any health details in it.
reply: Thank you for your email. Elena Ruiz is away from the office for at least the next two weeks and is not reading email. For anything about her team's work, please contact Omar Haddad at omar.haddad@example.com. Messages here won't be forwarded, so please resend anything important to Omar.
note: Written on someone's behalf: third person, no health details, and no return date that nobody has confirmed.

situation: 我叫阿芳，开了一家小饭馆“芳姐小厨”。楼上水管爆了，店里天花板和电路都要修，10月5日起停业，外卖也一起停，什么时候重新开还说不准，估计三到五周。储值卡余额全部保留，有效期按停业天数顺延；留言我每天晚上统一看一次。想设一个微信自动回复。
reply: 您好，芳姐小厨因为店内维修，10月5日起暂停营业，外卖也一起暂停。重新开业的日子还没定，估计三到五周，定了会第一时间在这里通知。储值卡余额全部保留，有效期按停业天数顺延，不用做任何操作。留言我每天晚上统一回复。谢谢大家等我们回来！阿芳
note: 复业日期没定就直说，给一个估计并承诺定了再通知；顾客最关心的储值卡写清楚。

situation: Sou a Beatriz e alugo dois apartamentos por temporada em Florianópolis; hóspedes e interessados me escrevem pelo WhatsApp. Vou viajar de 12 a 25 de outubro, quase sem internet, e volto a responder na segunda, 26 de outubro. Minha prima Lívia mora no apartamento 302 do mesmo prédio e topou cuidar de chaves, check-in e qualquer problema dos hóspedes; pedidos de novas reservas ficam para quando eu voltar.
reply: Oi! Estou viajando de 12 a 25 de outubro, quase sem internet, e volto a responder as mensagens na segunda, 26 de outubro. Se você está hospedado aqui e precisa de algo, como chaves, check-in ou um problema no apartamento, procure a Lívia no apartamento 302 do mesmo prédio. Pedidos de novas reservas eu respondo quando voltar. Obrigada!
note: Uma rota só, para quem está hospedado; quem quer reservar sabe exatamente quando terá resposta.

situation: 我是一家律所的行政主管，产假结束后先上半天班：10月12日到11月27日（周五），每天上午9点到12点，11月30日（周一）起恢复全天。下午不看邮件，下午的急事由同事何蕾（helei@example.com）处理。想设一个邮件自动回复，不想写原因。
reply: 您好，10月12日至11月27日，我每天上午9点到12点上班，下午不查看邮件，下午收到的邮件我会在下一个工作日上午处理。下午如有急事，请联系何蕾（helei@example.com）。11月30日（周一）起恢复全天办公。谢谢！
note: 阶段性半天上班：写清哪段时间在、什么时候回复、急事找谁，以及哪天恢复，原因不用写。

situation: I'm Zoe and I sell my pottery through Instagram, about 40k followers. I'm taking a break from Instagram from Monday 12 October to Sunday 8 November and won't open DMs at all. My online shop stays open and my assistant Kit ships orders every Wednesday; brand and collab inquiries can go to zoe.studio@example.com, which I'll check on Mondays.
reply: Hi! I'm taking a break from Instagram until Sunday 8 November and won't see DMs before then. The online shop is open as usual and orders ship every Wednesday. For collabs or brand work, email zoe.studio@example.com, which I check on Mondays. Talk soon, Zoe
note: A creator's away message still answers the two real questions: can I buy, and where do business inquiries go.

situation: I'm Ben, a UX designer based in Toronto. From Monday 12 October to Friday 30 October I'll be working from Tokyo, 13 hours ahead, still full time, online 9am to 5pm Tokyo time, which is 8pm to 4am Toronto time. My teammate Ana Lima (ana.lima@example.com) has agreed to cover anything that needs a same-day answer during Toronto hours.
reply: Thanks for your email. From Monday 12 October to Friday 30 October I'm working from Tokyo, 13 hours ahead of Toronto. I'm online 9am to 5pm Tokyo time, which is 8pm to 4am Toronto time, so you'll usually hear from me overnight. If you need an answer during Toronto hours the same day, please contact Ana Lima at ana.lima@example.com. Ben
note: Not away, just shifted: give your hours in the reader's time zone so they know when to expect a reply.
